_note: 日常薄场景补档 批次A(8个生活刚需)· v3 —— 按 5 视角对抗验证重构。核心修正:**一档 = 一条连贯叙事线,不是知识点清单**。v2 把每个场景的所有高频表达堆进 advanced 档,导致硬性矛盾(药已配好 vs 需事前授权 vs 缺货;要退货 vs 要补差价 vs 换货;还没到诊所 vs 已在面诊)。v3 每档只讲一个故事,被砍掉的知识点宁可不要,也不制造前后打架的台词。其余修正:①安全——台词表的句子顺序就是学员的行为顺序,失能信息与救护车请求必须前置且用陈述句(不能问『我该不该打』),问费用必须排在处置之后;②entry 档是给英语最差的人用的,必须给出正确的处置出口(剧痛呕吐→ER、钱包丢→先挂失卡、当街被抢→先报警);③对话对象全程一致(911接线员 / 到场警察 / 领馆 各自独立成档);④美式地道(schedule 不 book、slower 不 more slowly、the same doctor 不 provider、insurance company 不 insurer、take care of 不 sort out、taking new patients 不 accepting);⑤删掉放错场景的反诈骗句(本档是自己拨出的电话,不存在 incoming call)。保留现有 beginner 档不动。规格 entry 4 / intermediate 9 / advanced 11。

entry.en: Do I need a prescription for this?

intermediate.en: Hi, I'm here to pick up a prescription.
intermediate.zh: 你好，我来取处方药。

intermediate.en: It's under Chen — C-H-E-N.
intermediate.zh: 登记名是 Chen——C-H-E-N。

intermediate.en: Sure — my date of birth is May twelfth, nineteen eighty-five.
intermediate.zh: 好的——我的出生日期是 1985 年 5 月 12 日。

intermediate.en: Does my insurance cover this one?
intermediate.zh: 我的保险能覆盖这个药吗？

intermediate.en: Is there a generic version that's cheaper?
intermediate.zh: 有没有便宜一些的仿制药？

intermediate.en: I take a daily antihistamine for allergies — is that a problem with this?
intermediate.zh: 我每天吃一种抗组胺的过敏药——和这个会有冲突吗？

intermediate.en: Are there any foods or drinks I should avoid while I'm taking this?
intermediate.zh: 吃这个药期间，有什么食物或饮料要避开吗？

intermediate.en: I'm out of refills. Could you contact my doctor for a new prescription?
intermediate.zh: 我的续配次数用完了。能帮我联系医生重开处方吗？

intermediate.en: If it doesn't help, I'll check with my doctor.
intermediate.zh: 要是没效果，我再去问我的医生。

advanced.en: Hi, I'm here to pick up a prescription — I got the text that it's ready.
advanced.zh: 你好，我来取处方药——我收到短信说配好了。

advanced.en: Last time my copay was twenty dollars — is it the same this time?
advanced.zh: 上次我的自付额是二十美元——这次一样吗？

advanced.en: That's a lot higher than usual. Could you run it through my insurance again?
advanced.zh: 这比平时高不少。能麻烦你再用我的保险走一遍吗？

advanced.en: I just switched plans, so the card on file is probably out of date.
advanced.zh: 我刚换了保险计划，你们存档的卡应该已经过期了。

advanced.en: Here's my new card — could you try it with this one?
advanced.zh: 这是我的新卡——能用这张试一下吗？

advanced.en: If it's still that much, is there a manufacturer coupon or discount program?
advanced.zh: 如果还是这么贵，有厂家优惠券或折扣项目吗？

advanced.en: While you're in there, my doctor mentioned a lower dose — could you check what was actually sent over?
advanced.zh: 顺便，我的医生提过要开小剂量的——能帮我核对一下实际开过来的是什么吗？

advanced.en: Could you also set this up on auto-refill for me?
advanced.zh: 能顺便帮我设置成自动续药吗？

advanced.en: And I'm traveling next month — can you make a note that I may need to fill it early?
advanced.zh: 还有我下个月要出门——能备注一下我可能需要提前配药吗？

advanced.en: Are there any side effects I should watch for at this dose?
advanced.zh: 这个剂量有什么副作用需要留意吗？

advanced.en: Great — I'll wait right here while you reprocess it.
advanced.zh: 好的——你重新处理，我就在这儿等。

entry.en: I need to see a doctor.
I need to go to the emergency room.

intermediate.en: Hi, I'd like to see someone today if possible.
intermediate.zh: 你好，如果可以的话我想今天就看医生。

intermediate.en: I've never been in before — are you taking new patients?
intermediate.zh: 我以前没来过——你们现在收新病人吗？

intermediate.en: It started two days ago and it's getting worse.
intermediate.zh: 两天前开始的，而且越来越严重。

intermediate.en: I have a fever, a sore throat, and a bad headache.
intermediate.zh: 我发烧、喉咙痛，还有严重的头痛。

intermediate.en: I took some ibuprofen this morning but it didn't help much.
intermediate.zh: 我今天早上吃了布洛芬，但没什么用。

intermediate.en: I'm not allergic to anything as far as I know.
intermediate.zh: 据我所知我没有任何过敏。

intermediate.en: Are you in network with my plan, and what will my copay be?
intermediate.zh: 你们在我的保险网络内吗？我的自付额是多少？

intermediate.en: How long is the wait, roughly?
intermediate.zh: 大概要等多久？

intermediate.en: Thank you — I'll wait right here.
intermediate.zh: 谢谢——我就在这儿等。

advanced.en: I need to see someone right away — the pain keeps getting worse.
advanced.zh: 我需要马上看医生——这个疼一直在加重。

advanced.en: It's in the lower right side of my abdomen, and it's sharp.
advanced.zh: 在我腹部的右下方，是那种刺痛。

advanced.en: On a scale of one to ten, it's about a seven.
advanced.zh: 一到十分的话，大概七分。

advanced.en: It comes and goes, but the episodes are getting closer together.
advanced.zh: 是一阵一阵的，但发作间隔越来越短。

advanced.en: I haven't been able to keep any food down since last night.
advanced.zh: 从昨晚开始我吃什么吐什么。

advanced.en: I came alone, and I'm too dizzy to drive myself anywhere.
advanced.zh: 我是一个人来的，头晕得没法自己开车去别的地方。

advanced.en: I'm on medication for high blood pressure — I can show you the bottle.
advanced.zh: 我在吃降压药——我可以把药瓶给你看。

advanced.en: Can you evaluate me here, or do I need imaging somewhere else?
advanced.zh: 你们这儿能给我做评估吗，还是我需要去别处做影像检查？

advanced.en: If I need the ER, could someone call an ambulance for me?
advanced.zh: 如果我需要去急诊室，能有人帮我叫救护车吗？

advanced.en: If you do send me home, what symptoms should bring me straight back?
advanced.zh: 如果让我回家，出现什么症状我要立刻回来？

advanced.en: Once you've ruled out anything urgent, could you tell me roughly what the tests will cost?
advanced.zh: 等你们排除了紧急情况，能大概告诉我这些检查要多少钱吗？

entry.en: Sorry, the line keeps cutting out.
entry.zh: 抱歉，电话一直断断续续。

entry.en: Could you speak a little slower?

intermediate.en: Hi, I'm calling about an order I placed last week.
intermediate.zh: 你好，我想问一下我上周下的订单。

intermediate.en: I'd like to speak to a representative.
intermediate.zh: 我想转人工客服。

intermediate.en: Sure, my order number is 4-8-2-6-1.
intermediate.zh: 好的，我的订单号是 4-8-2-6-1。

intermediate.en: Sorry, could you spell that for me?
intermediate.zh: 抱歉，能帮我拼一下吗？

intermediate.en: Let me grab a pen — go ahead.
intermediate.zh: 我拿支笔——你说吧。

intermediate.en: So just to confirm, it'll arrive by Friday?
intermediate.zh: 所以我确认一下，周五之前会到，对吗？

intermediate.en: If we get disconnected, could you call me back at this number?
intermediate.zh: 万一断线了，能打这个号码回拨给我吗？

intermediate.en: Could you email me a confirmation?
intermediate.zh: 能给我发一封确认邮件吗？

intermediate.en: What should I do if it still hasn't arrived by Friday?
intermediate.zh: 如果周五还没到，我该怎么办？

advanced.en: Hi, I've been on hold for about twenty minutes — I hope you can help me figure this out.
advanced.zh: 你好，我已经等了大概二十分钟——希望你能帮我把这事弄清楚。

advanced.en: I've called twice about this already, so I'd rather not start from scratch.
advanced.zh: 这件事我已经打过两次电话了，所以我不想再从头讲一遍。

advanced.en: Could you pull up the notes from my previous call?
advanced.zh: 能调出我上次来电的记录吗？

advanced.en: I was told it would be resolved within three business days, and it's now been eight.
advanced.zh: 当时说三个工作日内解决，现在已经八天了。

advanced.en: I understand it's not your fault — I just need to know what happens next.
advanced.zh: 我理解这不是你的问题——我只是想知道接下来会怎么处理。

advanced.en: Is there a supervisor I could speak with about this?
advanced.zh: 这件事我能跟主管谈谈吗？

advanced.en: Before you transfer me, could you stay on the line until someone picks up?
advanced.zh: 转接之前，能麻烦你别挂，等有人接了再走吗？

advanced.en: Could you add a note to my account so I don't have to explain this again?
advanced.zh: 能在我的账户里加个备注吗？这样我下次就不用再解释一遍了。

advanced.en: So the refund will be back on my card in five to seven days. Is that right?
advanced.zh: 所以退款五到七天会回到我卡上。对吗？

advanced.en: Could you send that to my email so I have it in writing?
advanced.zh: 能把这个发到我邮箱吗？我好有个书面记录。

advanced.en: I appreciate you staying on this with me.
advanced.zh: 谢谢你一直帮我跟进这件事。

entry.en: Could you text me the address?
entry.zh: 能把地址发短信给我吗？

entry.en: Do I need to bring my insurance card?

intermediate.en: Hi, I'd like to schedule a cleaning with Dr. Lee if she's available.
intermediate.zh: 你好，如果 Lee 医生有空，我想约个洗牙。

intermediate.en: Do you validate parking, and which garage should I use?
intermediate.zh: 你们能给停车盖章吗？我该停哪个停车楼？

intermediate.en: Does my dental plan cover a routine cleaning, and will I owe anything out of pocket?
intermediate.zh: 我的牙科保险涵盖常规洗牙吗？我需要自付多少？

intermediate.en: Anything after three works, since I pick up my kid at two-thirty.
intermediate.zh: 三点以后都行，因为我两点半要去接孩子。

intermediate.en: Could you put me on the waitlist if something opens up sooner?
intermediate.zh: 如果有更早的空位，能把我放进候补名单吗？

intermediate.en: Do I need to fill out any forms before I come in?
intermediate.zh: 来之前我需要填什么表格吗？

intermediate.en: How early should I get there for my first visit?
intermediate.zh: 第一次去我该提前多久到？

intermediate.en: I'll need a Mandarin interpreter for the appointment. Could you arrange one?
intermediate.zh: 这次就诊我需要普通话翻译。能帮我安排一位吗？

intermediate.en: Perfect — see you on the fourteenth.
intermediate.zh: 太好了——十四号见。

advanced.en: Hi, I have an appointment on Thursday that I need to move.
advanced.zh: 你好，我周四有个预约需要改期。

advanced.en: Something came up at work, so I can't make that time anymore.
advanced.zh: 工作上有事，那个时间我去不了了。

advanced.en: I'm calling the moment I found out, but I realize this is less than twenty-four hours' notice.
advanced.zh: 我是一知道就打来的，但我明白这已经不到二十四小时了。

advanced.en: Is there any way to waive the fee, since this is my first time rescheduling?
advanced.zh: 考虑到这是我第一次改期，有办法免掉费用吗？

advanced.en: What's the next opening you have with the same doctor?
advanced.zh: 同一位医生下一个空位是什么时候？

advanced.en: I'd rather wait for her than see someone else, if that's not too far out.
advanced.zh: 如果不用等太久，我宁愿等她，也不换别人。

advanced.en: Could you double-check that my insurance is still active on your end?
advanced.zh: 能帮我再确认一下，你们那边我的保险还是有效的吗？

advanced.en: Last time there was a mix-up with my referral — has that been cleared up?
advanced.zh: 上次我的转诊单出过差错——那件事解决了吗？

advanced.en: If the referral expires before the new appointment, will I need a new one?
advanced.zh: 如果转诊单在新预约之前过期了，我需要重新开吗？

advanced.en: Could you confirm the new time by email so I have it in writing?
advanced.zh: 能把新时间用邮件确认一下吗，我好有个书面记录。

advanced.en: Thanks for working with me on that.
advanced.zh: 谢谢你帮我协调这件事。

entry.en: Does this come in another color?

intermediate.en: Excuse me, is this the sale price or the regular price?
intermediate.zh: 请问这是折后价还是原价？

intermediate.en: Is that the price before tax?
intermediate.zh: 这是税前价格吗？

intermediate.en: Is that price per pound, or is it per item?
intermediate.zh: 那个价格是按磅算还是按件算？

intermediate.en: Do you have this in a medium in the back?
intermediate.zh: 库房里还有中号的吗？

intermediate.en: Do you price-match other stores?
intermediate.zh: 你们跟别的商店比价吗？

intermediate.en: Is there a student or member discount?
intermediate.zh: 有学生折扣或会员折扣吗？

intermediate.en: Is this final sale, or can I still return it?
intermediate.zh: 这个是特价不退不换，还是还能退？

intermediate.en: Could I get a gift receipt with that?
intermediate.zh: 能给我开一张礼品小票吗？

intermediate.en: That works — I'll go ahead and get it.
intermediate.zh: 可以——那我就买了。

advanced.en: Hi, I bought this last week and I'd like to return it.
advanced.zh: 你好，这个我上周买的，我想退货。

advanced.en: I don't have the receipt, but could you look it up with the card I paid with?
advanced.zh: 我没带小票，但能用我付款的那张卡查到吗？

advanced.en: The tags are still on, and I never used it.
advanced.zh: 吊牌还在，我一次都没用过。

advanced.en: I'd prefer a refund to the original card rather than store credit.
advanced.zh: 我希望退回原卡，而不是 store credit。

advanced.en: I know the sale has ended, but your website says returns are good for fourteen days.
advanced.zh: 我知道折扣已经结束了，但你们网站上写退货期限是十四天。

advanced.en: Would you mind checking with a manager on that?
advanced.zh: 能麻烦你跟经理确认一下吗？

advanced.en: If a refund isn't possible, could I exchange it for a different color instead?
advanced.zh: 如果退不了，我能换成别的颜色吗？

advanced.en: Do you have that color in the store, or would I have to order it?
advanced.zh: 那个颜色店里有货吗，还是得订？

advanced.en: Is the warranty handled through you or through the manufacturer?
advanced.zh: 保修是你们负责还是找厂家？

advanced.en: And if the refund goes through instead, how long until it shows up on my card?
advanced.zh: 如果最后是退款，多久能显示在我卡上？

advanced.en: Thanks — I appreciate you taking care of that.
advanced.zh: 谢谢——谢谢你帮我处理好。

intermediate.en: Excuse me, am I supposed to check in at this machine first?
intermediate.zh: 请问，我是不是要先在这台机器上签到？

intermediate.en: I'm new here and still figuring things out.
intermediate.zh: 我刚来，很多事还在摸索。

intermediate.en: Is there someone here who speaks Mandarin?
intermediate.zh: 这儿有会说普通话的人吗？

intermediate.en: I can't get this machine to take my card.
intermediate.zh: 这台机器读不了我的卡。

intermediate.en: Would you mind walking me through it once?
intermediate.zh: 能麻烦你带我走一遍流程吗？

intermediate.en: Let me try it myself, and you can tell me if I'm doing anything wrong.
intermediate.zh: 我自己试一遍，做错了你告诉我。

intermediate.en: So I tap here first, and then choose the amount?
intermediate.zh: 所以我先点这里，然后选金额，对吗？

intermediate.en: That makes much more sense now.
intermediate.zh: 现在清楚多了。

intermediate.en: You've been really helpful.
intermediate.zh: 你帮了大忙。

advanced.en: Sorry to interrupt — I know you're busy, but I'm stuck on something.
advanced.zh: 不好意思打断一下——我知道你很忙，但我卡在一个问题上。

advanced.en: The machine charged my card, but it didn't print anything.
advanced.zh: 机器扣了我的卡，但什么都没打出来。

advanced.en: Could you check whether the payment actually went through before I try again?
advanced.zh: 在我再试一次之前，能帮我确认这笔钱到底扣成功了没有吗？

advanced.en: I don't want to be charged twice.
advanced.zh: 我不想被扣两次钱。

advanced.en: I have a photo of the screen right before it froze — would that help?
advanced.zh: 我拍了它卡住之前的屏幕照片——那个有用吗？

advanced.en: So if I understand right, I just wait for it to drop off my statement?
advanced.zh: 所以如果我理解得没错，我只要等它从账单上自动撤掉，对吗？

advanced.en: Let me repeat that back to make sure I've got it.
advanced.zh: 我复述一遍，确认我记对了。

advanced.en: If it's still there next week, who should I contact?
advanced.zh: 如果下周它还在，我该联系谁？

advanced.en: Is there a support number I can call, or does it have to be in person?
advanced.zh: 有客服电话我可以打吗，还是必须本人到场？

advanced.en: Could I get your name, in case I need to reference this later?
advanced.zh: 能告诉我你的名字吗？万一之后我需要提到这次沟通。

advanced.en: You've saved me a lot of trouble — thank you.
advanced.zh: 你帮我省了好多麻烦——谢谢你。

entry.en: I think I left it here.
I need to call my bank right away.
entry.zh: 我得马上给银行打电话。

intermediate.en: Hi, I think I left my bag here about an hour ago.
intermediate.zh: 你好，我想我大概一小时前把包落在这儿了。

intermediate.en: It's a black backpack with a laptop inside.
intermediate.zh: 是个黑色双肩包，里面有台笔记本电脑。

intermediate.en: I was sitting by the window near the entrance.
intermediate.zh: 我当时坐在靠近入口的窗边。

intermediate.en: Has anyone turned anything in today?
intermediate.zh: 今天有人送来失物吗？

intermediate.en: Could you check in the back or ask one of your coworkers?
intermediate.zh: 能查一下后面，或者问问你同事吗？

intermediate.en: Do you have security cameras here? Could you save the footage in case the police need it?
intermediate.zh: 这儿有监控吗？能麻烦你把录像保存下来吗，万一警察需要。

intermediate.en: Could I leave my name and number in case it shows up?
intermediate.zh: 我能留个姓名和电话吗？万一找到了。

intermediate.en: Is there a number I could call later to follow up?
intermediate.zh: 有电话号码吗？我晚点可以再跟进。

intermediate.en: Thanks — I'll check back this evening.
intermediate.zh: 谢谢——我今晚再来看看。

advanced.en: Hi, I need to replace my lost Chinese passport. What's the process?
advanced.zh: 你好，我的中国护照丢了，需要补办。流程是怎样的？

advanced.en: I've already retraced my steps and checked with the places I visited.
advanced.zh: 我已经原路找过一遍，也问过去过的地方了。

advanced.en: I'm not sure whether I lost it or it was stolen. Does that change what I need to do?
advanced.zh: 我不确定是丢了还是被偷了。这会影响我要办的手续吗？

advanced.en: Do you need a police report, or is a written statement enough?
advanced.zh: 你们需要警方报案记录吗，还是一份书面声明就够了？

advanced.en: What documents do I need to upload through the consular services app?
advanced.zh: 我需要通过领事服务的 APP 上传哪些材料？

advanced.en: Will I need to come in to have my fingerprints taken?
advanced.zh: 我需要本人到馆采集指纹吗？

advanced.en: I have a photo of the passport page on my phone — would that help?
advanced.zh: 我手机里有护照页的照片——那个有用吗？

advanced.en: I need to return to China in five days. Would a travel document be faster than a new passport?
advanced.zh: 我五天后必须回中国。旅行证会比补办护照更快吗？

advanced.en: My U.S. visa was in that passport — will I have to reapply for it outside the country?
advanced.zh: 我的美国签证在那本护照里——我需要在境外重新申请吗？

advanced.en: Could you tell me the address and the hours?
advanced.zh: 能告诉我地址和办公时间吗？

advanced.en: Thank you — that's much clearer now.
advanced.zh: 谢谢你——现在清楚多了。

intermediate.en: I need police at 123 Main Street, apartment 4B — someone broke into my apartment and may still be inside.
intermediate.zh: 我需要警察来 Main Street 123 号 4B 公寓——有人闯进了我家，可能还在里面。

intermediate.en: I got home a few minutes ago and found the door open.
intermediate.zh: 我几分钟前到家，发现门开着。

intermediate.en: I haven't gone inside — I don't know if anyone is still in there.
intermediate.zh: 我没进去——我不知道里面是不是还有人。

intermediate.en: I'm outside the building now, in a safe place.
intermediate.zh: 我现在在楼外，在一个安全的地方。

intermediate.en: Can you send officers right away?
intermediate.zh: 能马上派警察过来吗？

intermediate.en: My number is 213-555-0142, in case we get cut off.
intermediate.zh: 我的电话是 213-555-0142，万一断线了。

intermediate.en: I'll stay on the line until they get here.
intermediate.zh: 我会一直不挂断，等他们到。

intermediate.en: Should I wait out front so they can see me?
intermediate.zh: 我要在楼前等着，好让他们看到我吗？

intermediate.en: Is there anything I shouldn't touch when we go in?
intermediate.zh: 等我们进去之后，有什么是我不该碰的吗？

advanced.en: Thanks for coming out so quickly, officer.
advanced.zh: 谢谢你们这么快就赶到，警官。

advanced.en: Could I have a Mandarin interpreter, please?
advanced.zh: 能给我安排一位普通话翻译吗？

advanced.en: I got home around six and found the door open, so I waited outside until you arrived.
advanced.zh: 我大概六点到家，发现门开着，就在外面等到你们来。

advanced.en: Now that I've been inside with you, I can see my laptop and some cash are missing.
advanced.zh: 刚才跟你们一起进去看过，我发现笔记本电脑和一些现金不见了。

advanced.en: I have the serial number for the laptop and photos of the other items.
advanced.zh: 我有笔记本电脑的序列号，还有其他物品的照片。

advanced.en: The building manager said he can pull the hallway footage if you request it.
advanced.zh: 楼管说如果你们要求，他可以调取走廊的监控录像。

advanced.en: Could you give me the DR number for this report?
advanced.zh: 能给我这次报案的 DR 编号吗？

advanced.en: My insurance company will need documentation — can I start the claim with that number?
advanced.zh: 我的保险公司需要证明材料——我能用这个编号先开理赔吗？

advanced.en: How do I request a copy of the full report later on?
advanced.zh: 之后我怎么申请一份完整报告的副本？

advanced.en: Is there anything I should do to secure the place tonight?
advanced.zh: 今晚我需要做些什么来保障住处安全吗？

advanced.en: If I notice anything else missing, who should I contact?
advanced.zh: 如果我发现还少了别的东西，该联系谁？
